description.value: The study examined food-related neural activation in adolescents with normal weight or overweight/obesity under sleep-restricted and habitual sleep conditions using fMRI during a food inhibition go/no-go task.

spans.text: Our study examined food-related neural activation in brain regions associated with food reward and inhibition in adolescents under sleep-restricted and well-rested conditions.

description.value: A two-phase crossover design in which participants spent either 5 hours per night in bed at home or 9 hours per night in bed at home for five consecutive nights, with assessments after each phase.

spans.text: The experimental procedure comprised a two-phase crossover design in which participants spent either 5 hours per night in bed at home (restricted sleep) or 9 hours per night in bed at home (habitual sleep).
